item.title: Seattle Torrent place captain Hilary Knight on injured reserve
item.description: The Seattle Torrent have placed captain Hilary Knight on long-term injured reserve with a lower-body injury sustained while leading U.S. Women's Hockey to a gold medal at the Winter Olympics in Milan.

item.title: Bothell, WA mother ‘shocked’ daughter's suspected murderer bonded out of jail
item.description: The mother of Mallory Barbour, the woman found dead in Bothell in 2025, said she was “shocked" and “disappointed" to learn the man suspected of murdering her daughter is out of custody.

item.title: Thousands of people from across the country flock to Seattle for Pokémon
item.description: Thousands of people from across the county are in Seattle this weekend for the Pokémon Regional Championships.

item.title: UW to host Great Britain, Canada in 2026 Windermere Cup
item.description: Washington Rowing will host teams from Canada, Great Britain and Northeastern University for the 2026 Windermere Cup.

item.title: Without Hilary Knight, Seattle Torrent fall 5-2 to Sceptres in return from Olympics
item.description: With captain Hilary Knight out of the lineup due to injury, the Seattle Torrent couldn't reward a record-breaking crowd on Friday night with a victory in a 5-2 loss to the Toronto Sceptres.

item.title: Seattle weather: Chilly mornings, sunny skies into afternoon over weekend
item.description: It will be a chilly start Saturday with a few morning clouds, but skies will be dry this weekend with more sunshine.

item.title: WA politicians, communities react to Iran strikes by Trump administration, Israel
item.description: The Washington community is reacting to "major combat operations" by the U.S. and Israel unfolding in Iran heading into the weekend, including protesting and statements from politicians.

item.title: Police hunt for suspect in deadly Bellevue, WA hit-and-run crash
item.description: An elderly woman is dead after being hit by a car in a parking lot this morning. Police in Bellevue are looking for the driver involved in a deadly hit-and-run crash on Saturday.

item.title: University of Washington retires jersey of legendary Detlef Schrempf
item.description: Legendary Husky-turned-Supersonic Detlef Schrempf was honored Saturday in Seattle as the University of Washington officially retired his no. 22 jersey.

item.title: Jordan Eberle scores twice as Seattle Kraken roll to 5-1 win over Canucks
item.description: Jordan Eberle had a pair of goals and an assist, Chandler Stephenson had a goal and two assists as the Kraken earned their first victory after the Winter Olympics break in a 5-1 romp over the Canucks.
